data.title: Nvidia Spending Pushes AI Data Center Infrastructure Stocks Into Focus
data.description: Nvidia’s huge Q3 beat, raised 2028 sales outlook and that eye catching US$150b buyback have turned the AI data center build out from a headline into a concrete spending plan. Capital is flowing into the plumbing behind AI, not just the chips in the spotlight. This article walks through three stocks exposed to this surge, and explains why the same news could be a reason to lean in or step back. The few stocks highlighted below are just a sample, and the full screen surfaced 49 more companies...
